title: Select and confirm an invoice batch
want: choose several invoices and confirm the processing rules
benefit: I know which files, data and reader will be used
status: Local and hosted processing gate verified
acceptance: Cancel sends no invoice-processing request.
A confirmed plan is bound to filenames/sizes, engine/model, reference version and tolerances.
Changed rules require a fresh confirmation.
Each file becomes one invoice job; up to two run concurrently and the rest remain visibly queued.

title: Read digital invoices and scans
want: extract headers and every item line from supported files
status: Local and hosted paths measured on bounded cases; broad 95% quality remains unproven
acceptance: Native AI-off conversion recovered 570/570 lines and 3,990/3,990 tested line facts on one 15-PDF layout family; Paddle has a conservative 90.91% floor with descriptions unproven, while a separate bounded adaptive local two-page path improved from 90/99 (90.9%) to 96/99 (97.0%) with 23/23 rows, about 168 seconds combined and 2.31 GiB peak memory. Revision 00008 introduced Paddle's 360-second budget and 150-second eligibility ceiling; its hosted Paddle run completed the adaptive path in 242.98 seconds and returned the same 23 rows and 96/99 facts. A separate hosted managed-AI check returned 23 rows and 97/99 facts in 16.18 seconds. Docling stays capped at 240 seconds and exposes its 10/23 result on that scan and ten-page limitations.
A readable PDF with no matching template keeps native text; conservative rules require an invoice heading, reject purchase orders and never infer internal codes or totals.
A scanned invoice2data route names Paddle as its image-text input in the trace.
The job view names the active extraction stage and separates engine failure from text-only output with zero structured items; field completeness is read coverage, not accuracy.
Unsupported, encrypted, oversized and multi-invoice files receive a clear exception or split instruction.

title: Use a chosen AI connection for exceptions
want: select a provider/model and enable automatic fallback
benefit: unfamiliar layouts can be proposed for review
status: Adapter contracts and bounded hosted managed-AI checks passed; representative accuracy and live subscription inference remain pending
acceptance: Managed Vertex uses the hosted service identity and project billing; every AI path still requires an explicitly confirmed plan.
Provider output must pass the strict invoice schema; missing facts remain missing.
Saved credentials are distinct from verified access; an available connected model is offered only when no connected model is selected and never replaces a still-connected user selection.
Credentials never appear in browser storage, exported files or ordinary API errors.
Mocked Claude and ChatGPT adapters do not imply live subscription eligibility or inference.
The measured one-layout result cannot establish the expected 95% across suppliers, scans, languages and lengths; frozen held-out gold still governs acceptance.

title: Map and approve business reference extracts
want: profile the whole item and PO/GRN files and approve explicit mappings
benefit: the validator uses evidence with known meaning
status: Atomic cutover completed with 412,139 live evidence rows, exact item/PO counts and a sanitized archive receipt beginning d06678; authenticated API and References UI lookup QA passed
acceptance: Preserve original bytes, hashes and row/column provenance; inspect all populated cells.
Separate unique matches, duplicates, ambiguous joins and missing fields.
Identifier and fuzzy product-name searches show source/conflict context plus price/quantity/unit clues and require explicit human confirmation without approving matching data.
Unknown seller, printed buyer name versus internal buyer/company code, route, receipt acceptance and invoiced baseline block approval; never default them silently.

title: Match the exact supplier route and items
want: check supplier, site, company, PO, item identity and unit
benefit: an invoice cannot borrow approval from another market or entity
acceptance: Domestic and cross-border routes require their exact approval tuple.
Conflicting SKU and barcode identity is held.
Location type comes from an explicit reference field, not a numeric prefix.

title: Protect receipt quantity and commercial controls
want: check price, accepted receipt balance and tax with decimal rules
benefit: we avoid incorrect or duplicate charges
acceptance: Accepted receipts minus returns, external baseline and this app allocations determine available quantity.
Repeated lines and multiple invoices consume quantity cumulatively.
Tolerance and currency rounding are explicit; no credit or mixed-tax allocation is invented.

title: Review evidence and resolve exceptions
want: compare the source with editable fields and record review
benefit: every exported value has checked evidence
acceptance: Review confirmation cannot override validation holds.
Concurrent edits with stale revisions are rejected.
Rules changing during extraction prevent stale approval and require a new processing plan.
A manual draft created from an active job cannot alter the job revision, extracted invoice or review status.
Printed line net/tax amounts survive edits without changing printed unit price; there is no automatic repricing.
Printed buyer name remains separate from the internal buyer/company code; a visible name cannot populate the code without approved reference evidence.

title: Download combined review or approved workbooks
want: download one combined workbook for saved processed invoices and a separate approved export
benefit: review can move quickly without weakening approval controls
acceptance: Header/Tax_Breakdown/Details have exactly 13/3/6 columns and no helper formulas.
Invoice transaction IDs are 1..N and consistent across all three sheets.
EXTRACTION_REVIEW_ONLY accepts saved processed records, keeps unknown codes blank and changes no job, approval, ledger or allocation.
Export rechecks and reserves quantities atomically; repeat download does not duplicate an allocation.

title: Recover and audit local operations
want: retain sources, rule versions, edits and exports
benefit: a failed reader or restart can be explained and retried
status: Instance-replacement persistence verified; database backup restoration remains a production gate
acceptance: Restarted in-flight jobs visibly require retry; completed exports remain downloadable.
Export records include reference version, policy and allocations.
Recovery procedure preserves the database plus the corresponding encryption key.
Audit distinguishes text read, fields extracted and extraction failed; the legacy extracted event means only that a reader run finished.

title: Run a restricted cloud workspace
want: sign in to a Firebase frontend backed by durable GCP services
benefit: the team can use a hosted portal without losing evidence on restart
status: Hosted synthetic workflow and instance-replacement persistence verified
acceptance: Unauthenticated and non-allowlisted accounts cannot access invoices, references or connections.
Database and document evidence survive a replacement application instance.
Live UI, auth rejection, synthetic extraction/export and persistence smoke checks pass before operational handoff.

Final revision inv-studio-api-00009-vxw has 100% traffic; Paddle, managed AI, authenticated API/browser lookup, deletion/model controls and cancel-dialog behavior passed. The allowlist is owner-only, the owner account remained email-verified, unauthenticated API calls are denied and the smoke identity was deleted.

title: Qualify suppliers for a new store or market
want: reuse approved coverage and start discovery only for gaps
benefit: store openings do not repeat every supplier task
acceptance: Same-market coverage reuses valid route facts with provenance/expiry.
New market or buying entity creates an explicit qualification case.
AI suggestions cannot approve a legal entity, route or commercial agreement.

title: Normalize supplier items for buying and digital channels
want: turn varied supplier files into approved item identities and channel content
benefit: purchasing and commerce teams can reuse a consistent catalog
acceptance: Supplier codes, internal items, barcodes, packaging and units have explicit mappings.
Conflicting identities and unit conversions need steward approval.
Channel-specific text, attributes, images and translations are versioned separately from purchasing identity.

title: Download an explicitly unvalidated manual draft
want: edit every target workbook field and download a draft while OCR is still running
benefit: urgent manual work is not blocked by a slow reader
status: Implemented and hosted; job and ledger non-mutation checks passed
acceptance: Header/Tax_Breakdown/Details expose exactly 13/3/6 editable fields with one joined transaction, leading-zero-safe identifiers and Decimal arithmetic.
Download requires an explicit unvalidated acknowledgement and visible DRAFT_UNVALIDATED/no-reservation disclosure.
Draft creation does not change the job, approve references, write the approved export ledger or reserve receipts.

title: Search large source extracts without implying approval
want: search actual item and PO sources by identifier or product name
benefit: I can find evidence without loading unapproved rows into canonical matching
status: Atomic cutover completed with 412,139 live source-evidence rows and exact item/PO counts; authenticated API and References UI lookup QA passed and lookup cannot approve canonical matching
acceptance: Results retain source row and conflict/duplicate context with filters, bounded pagination and visible name/price/quantity/unit matching clues.
The operator explicitly confirms a selected result before it can populate the manual workspace.
Lookup source evidence is never represented as approved matching, receipt allocation or export readiness.

title: Move an owner subscription connection to the hosted workspace
want: connect the restricted Claude CLI or move my ChatGPT registration into my authenticated hosted workspace
benefit: the provider can use my authorized account without exposing credentials through browser state
status: Hosted model controls passed managed-Vertex autoload/retry and visible bad-key rejection; live Claude/ChatGPT subscription inference remains unverified
acceptance: Claude setup tokens are encrypted, omitted from state, removable and supplied only to the restricted server CLI with tools disabled.
ChatGPT local export creates a one-time bundle and then deletes local encrypted credentials, disconnects and clears the active account.
Only authenticated cloud owners can import; cloud export and local import are denied, and tests do not imply live provider eligibility.

title: Permanently remove invoice data with explicit retention
want: delete selected invoices with a clear retention receipt
benefit: live evidence is removed without breaking duplicate or receipt controls
status: Implemented and hosted deletion verification passed
acceptance: Deletion requires explicit permanent confirmation and current job revisions; active jobs and partial exported batches are rejected atomically.
Live job payloads, source objects, detailed invoice audit, generated exports and batch workbooks are removed.
Approved invoices retain only the invoice key and PO-line quantity allocations required for duplicate and receipt controls, plus a minimal deletion audit without invoice content.
Provider backups, logs, object versions and soft-deleted copies follow provider retention and are outside the live-store action.
